definitions.explanation: An upright container kept on the kitchen counter or dining table that holds chopsticks, and often spoons and forks, standing on end.

examples.japanese: {箸|はし}{立|た}てに{箸|はし}を{戻|もど}す。
examples.english: Put the chopsticks back in the holder.

examples.japanese: {箸|はし}{立|た}ては{時々|ときどき}{洗|あら}ったほうがいい。
examples.english: You should wash the chopstick holder from time to time.

examples.japanese: {食卓|しょくたく}の{真|ま}ん{中|なか}に{箸|はし}{立|た}てと{調味料|ちょうみりょう}が{置|お}いてある。
examples.english: A chopstick holder and the seasonings sit in the middle of the dining table.

notes:
From {箸|はし} (chopsticks) plus {立|た}てる (to stand something up) — a stand that holds chopsticks upright.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {箸|はし}{立|た}てに{入|い}れる: to put into the chopstick holder
- {箸|はし}{立|た}てを{洗|あら}う: to wash the chopstick holder
- {水|みず}{切|き}り{付|つ}きの{箸|はし}{立|た}て: a draining chopstick holder

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {箸|はし}{置|お}き: chopstick rest — the small piece you lay chopsticks across during a meal, quite different from a standing container
- {箸箱|はしばこ}: chopstick case — a lidded box for carrying chopsticks to school or work
